# hyperfluid_nextflow (Data Source)

Look up an environment's Nextflow deployment by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

data "hyperfluid_nextflow" "this" {
  env  = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
  name = "genomics"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id.
- `name` (String) Deployment name.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Set of String) Buckets the pipelines may read and write.
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `id` (String) Deployment id.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase.
- `resolved_runtime_image` (String) Runtime image in use.
- `slug` (String) Derived slug.
- `tags` (List of String) User-defined tags.
- `task_namespace` (String) Namespace the tasks run in.
- `work_volume_capacity` (String) Bound capacity of the work volume.
